### Observed differences

- The largest difference concerns six activities late in the process (by event position). In the earlier window, A33, A35 and A36 each appeared in about 49 in 100 traces and A37, A38 and A39 in about 52 in 100; in the later window, each of the six appears in about 98–100 in 100 traces (197–199 of 200). Together the six occurred about three times per trace before and about six times per trace after, while remaining essentially once-per-trace activities whenever they occur. [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010]
- Routing into and within this segment changed accordingly. Before, A30's outgoing transitions were spread over all six activities (roughly 15–18% each); in the later window about 96% go to A35, A33 or A36 combined and only about 2% to A37, A38 or A39. A33, A35 and A36 now also lead to A37, A38 and A39 (about 7–13% each), and the pairs A33→A37 and A36→A37, seen in 1 of 200 traces before, occur in about 195 in 200 traces after. [DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, LAG009, LAG014]
- A31's relation to the segment changed while its own presence did not: A31 still occurs in every trace at a similar position (mean about 0.80 before, 0.82 after), but A30 followed by A31 within five steps falls from 199 of 200 traces to 5 of 200, A33, A35 and A36 are now followed by A31 at lags of 4–5 instead of 1–3, and their direct successor shares to A31 drop from about 27–34% to under 1%. [LAG004, LAG008, LAG011, LAG013, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, POS004]
- Positions shifted modestly: A33, A35 and A36 now occur slightly earlier (mean about 0.74 before, 0.67–0.68 after), A37, A38 and A39 slightly later (about 0.73 before, 0.76 after), and A30 earlier (about 0.67 before, 0.62 after). [POS003, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009, POS010]
- Away from this segment, A04 participation fell from about 59 in 100 traces to about 26 in 100, and it occurs later and more variably (mean position about 0.20 before, 0.38 after; 75th percentile about 0.17 before, 0.67 after). A14 now leads to A15 in about 79% of its observed outgoing transitions (before about 43%) and to A04 in about 12% (before about 57%); A14 followed by A04 within five steps falls from 114 to 33 traces and is no longer always immediate. [OCC002, POS001, DIR004, LAG002, LAG001]
- A02, A08 and A10 occur more often, from about 5–8 in 100 traces before to about 18–23 in 100 after; their outgoing profiles also differ, but these rest on modest counts (11–15 traces before, 35–50 after). [OCC001, OCC003, OCC004, DIR001, DIR003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the late-process segment involving A30, A33, A35, A36, A37, A38, A39 and A31 is executed differently in the later window: A33, A35, A36, A37, A38 and A39, previously each present in about half of the traces, are now present in nearly every trace, and the segment runs as a fuller sequence — A30 leads almost exclusively to A35/A33/A36, these lead on to A37/A38/A39, and A31, still present in every trace, follows the segment at larger distances instead of directly after A30/A33/A35/A36. [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, LAG004, LAG008, LAG009, LAG011, LAG013, LAG014]

This goes beyond what chance would produce: screening qualified 46 items where fewer than 1 (0.86) would be expected if nothing had changed, and each item's difference exceeds about 995 in 1000 random re-splits of the pooled traces. The participation shifts are large and well backed (about 100 traces per activity before, 197–199 after), consistent across occurrence, position, successor and lag indicators, and the relational changes around A31 are observed directly rather than inferred from position shifts alone. The evidence cannot rule out that the two windows draw on different mixes of cases, which would produce the same picture without a change in routing; it also shows the new execution pattern, not the reason for it. [OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010, LAG004, LAG008, LAG011, LAG013]

Other differences: A04 is executed in about half as many traces as before (about 59 vs 26 in 100) and A14 is rerouted from A04 towards A15; A02, A08 and A10 have become more frequent. These affect an earlier part of the process and may be independent of the late-segment change; the evidence cannot establish whether they are connected, and the A02/A08/A10 increases in particular rest on few observations. [OCC002, POS001, DIR004, LAG002, OCC001, OCC003, OCC004]
